svg.title: The old plan stops at 0.30 after 47 picks. The lazy plan reaches 1.0 after 73 picks, and the full scan after 58.
svg.text: Scoring every candidate once lets the greedy plan reach full coverage,
Coverage after each pick on “A banjo has five strings and a horse has four” (pythia-70m). The old plan
scores only the first 120 candidates by attribution. The grey line is the target.
